whyItMatters: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext.
actions: Use the HTTPS endpoint the registry publishes and keep the hostname in the configuration reviewable. Specifically: fix a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm nuget.config no longer carries a `<packageSources><add>` entry over cleartext.
